description: This Java source file defines an abstract class `AbstractLoanItemListener` that provides mechanisms for handling errors and skips in batch processing of loan records within the Apache Fineract project. It manages transactionally updating loan account locks when errors occur during reading, processing, or writing, emphasizing error handling and logging.

classes.name: AbstractLoanItemListener
classes.description: An abstract class providing error handling and logging for batch operations involving Loan entities, including transactionally updating loan lock statuses when errors occur.

methods.name: updateAccountLockWithError
methods.description: Updates the error state of loan account locks within a new transaction when an error occurs during batch processing.

methods.name: onReadError
methods.description: Handles errors that occur during reading Loan records, logs the issue, and updates the lock status if the error is a LoanReadException.

methods.name: onProcessError
methods.description: Handles errors during processing of individual Loan items, logs the issue, and updates the relevant lock.

methods.name: onWriteError
methods.description: Handles errors during writing a chunk of Loan items, logs the issue, and updates the locks for all impacted loans.

methods.name: onSkipInRead
methods.description: Logs skip events during read operations.

methods.name: onSkipInProcess
methods.description: Logs skip events during process operations for a Loan.

methods.name: onSkipInWrite
methods.description: Logs skip events during write operations for a Loan.

methods.name: getLockOwner
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to specify the LockOwner associated with this listener.
